continuing_resources.units: source pulses per native attempt, not physical energy or time

renewal.domain: The fixed60 supplied codes; uniform complete seam attempts; fixed endpoint weights; arbitrary history-dependent C/E choices and adaptive/randomized legal-core resets; every attempt restored to a legal code, no halting/postselection to evade attempts.
renewal.proof: Extend h by zero on forbidden cores. Every native attempt lowers its conditional expectation by one. A counted reset raises h by at most max(h); telescope. Reset only at the boundary to an h-maximizer attains renewal mean max(h).
